changes.comment: Make the web/MCP servers reverse-proxy aware (#1371). New GRACKLE_PUBLIC_URL (--public-url) is the canonical browser-facing origin behind a TLS-terminating proxy: it drives the OAuth authorization-server metadata scheme/host, the session cookie Secure flag, HSTS emission, the pairing/QR URL, and the channel webhook ingress base URL. GRACKLE_MCP_ORIGIN now also fixes the MCP server's OAuth resource identifier / token audience (RFC 9728) so it isn't a downgraded http:// URL behind TLS. When both are unset, behavior is unchanged (loopback http defaults). Remediation for draft advisory GHSA-wcpf-6gwv-47c8 (Pattern E).
